name: dsh-plugin-seo
description: SEO 体检 for DeepSeek Harness — 说一句「SEO 体检」并给网址，DSH 按 Google Search Central 官方页逐条判六个维度，一页报告每条带证据和官方页地址，你点头它才改工作区里的站文件，部署是你做；不批量产页、不做外链、不抓 Google 结果页、不承诺排名。SEO checkup for DeepSeek Harness: say “SEO 体检” with a URL and DSH judges six dimensions against Google Search Central's own pages, writes a one-page report with evidence and the official page for every finding, edits site files in the workspace only after you approve each fix, and leaves deploying to you; no bulk pages, no link building, no scraping Google results, no ranking promises.
